rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before proceeding. It inspected the user’s orders, identified the pending order with the fleece jacket, requested explicit confirmation before attempting a change, and when the tool indicated removal wasn’t possible, it properly offered an exchange or full cancellation per policy and the user’s stated preference. The agent then obtained explicit confirmation (including a reason) before cancelling the order, executed the cancellation successfully, and reported the correct order status and refund to the correct payment method. For the grills inquiry, the agent read relevant orders, identified the two grill items in the delivered order, and accurately calculated and reported the total paid. No actions were taken without confirmation, no unsupported facts were invented beyond a standard refund timeframe, and no cross-account or policy violations occurred.
